name: Detail callouts: magnifier
when: The voice points out three tiny details near the middle of one frozen shot. A loupe opens on the first, then glides in an arc to the next two while the rest of the shot sits in a blur. Keep it for very small details; screenshot2-A is the workhorse.
anchor: The lens is open on detail 1 at `at1`, lands on detail 2 at `at2` and on detail 3 at `at3`: each on its word.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.shot: the frozen shot: a 1920x1080 still in the project's assets/
vars.shot_blur: the same still, blurred and dimmed to 60 %, baked with ffmpeg (no tint): ffmpeg -i shot.jpg -vf "gblur=sigma=6:steps=3,colorchannelmixer=rr=0.6:gg=0.6:bb=0.6" -q:v 2 shot_blur.jpg
vars.lens1_x: detail 1: the still point under the lens centre, in pixels of the 1920x1080 still (lens1_y); same for lens2_x/lens2_y and lens3_x/lens3_y: find it with find_box.mjs (grid, zoom, check, then the blind check), never by eye
vars.at1: seconds after the start: the lens is open on detail 1 (it starts opening 0.33 s before)
vars.at2: seconds after the start: the lens lands on detail 2 (the hop takes 0.8 s); at least 1.5 s after at1
vars.at3: seconds after the start: the lens lands on detail 3 (the hop takes 0.6 s); at least 1.3 s after at2
vars.out: seconds after the start: the lens starts to close; the scene can end 0.37 s later, or hold the sharp shot up to 0.57 s as validated

changed: The magnification pulls in over 15 frames instead of 16 (entry 0.5 s) and the lens closes in 9 frames instead of 11 (exit 0.3 s): the same curves with a sliver trimmed off the slow end. The shot and its blurred copy are file values. The ground behind the still is gone: the still always covers the frame.
